pydantic.text: pydantic-core defines CoreSchema, used throughout pydantic, as a large union of TypedDicts, but only when MYPY is false. Mypy and Zuban treat MYPY as true and see Mapping[str, Any] instead, a much simpler type to check. Pyright, Pyrefly and ty check the full union, so their times on this package include work Mypy and Zuban skip.
